name: Jesus Arrested
overview: The arrest of Jesus marks a pivotal moment in the Gospel narrative, where Judas, one of the twelve disciples, leads a multitude armed with swords and staves from the religious authorities to seize Him, as described in Matthew 26:47, Mark 14:43, and Luke 22:47. Despite Jesus speaking at the time, He is betrayed with a kiss, highlighting the depth of betrayal. Following this, His disciples abandon Him and flee, emphasizing Jesus' solitary path to the cross (Mark 14:50). The scene begins with Jesus intentionally entering the garden beyond the brook Cedron, fully aware of the events to come (John 18:1).
